title: Trojes residents block road seeking state road repair after Eta
location: Cifuentes / Planes road junction, Trojes, El Paraíso, Honduras

start_date.summary: Article dated Nov. 12 says protest occurred “throughout this Thursday, Nov. 12”.

location.summary: Cifuentes community, Planes junction in Trojes, El Paraíso; the access road to Danlí.

demands.summary: Residents demanded government public-works action: heavy equipment and repair of the road damaged by Eta. Coded as a public-policy choice pending review.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No numerical or clearly supported qualitative turnout; threshold cannot be established.

notes: One contemporary local/rights report documents an executed, localized action and domestic public-works demand. No crowd number; not verified. Disaster-response protests in other municipalities should not be merged absent continuity evidence.
